title: calamagrostis stricta var. groenlandica
intro: Calamagrostis stricta var. groenlandica, commonly known as Greenland bentgrass, is a perennial grass native to the Arctic tundra and high-latitude regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and reduce the risk of cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Greenland bentgrass are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
